snippet.title: Virtuoso | Launch Trailer (Meta Quest, Rift & SteamVR)
snippet.description:
Grab an instrument and get ready to jam in Virtuoso, your own virtual music stage! This VR musical sandbox lets anyone play and perform music in new, immersive ways. Explore a range of unique instruments made for VR and share your tracks with the world!

Virtuoso is OUT NOW on Meta Quest, Rift & SteamVR!

• Quest: https://ocul.us/3uF5pCs
• SteamVR: https://bit.ly/3oDcekl

Follow Virtuoso here:

• Twitter: https://twitter.com/VrVirtuoso
• TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@virtuosovr
• Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/virtuosovr/
• Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/VirtuosoVR
• Discord: http://www.discord.gg/virtuoso

Read more about the game on https://virtuoso-vr.com/

Virtuoso is made by Really Interactive and published by Fast Travel Games. 
About Really Interactive: https://www.really-interactive.se/
About Fast Travel Games: https://fasttravelgames.com/ 

#vr #music #quest2 #steamvr
